snippet.title: Tony Hawk's Project 8 PSP Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Tony Hawk's Project 8 PSP Gameplay HD.

Tony Hawk's Project 8, officially abbreviated as THP8, is a skateboarding video game, the eighth installment in the Tony Hawk's series. It was released on PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Xbox, Xbox 360, and PlayStation Portable.
